data.name: Hint_Body
data.value: On your iPhone or iPad, open Control Centre, tap Screen Mirroring and choose:

data.name: Hint_StoppedBody
data.value: Press Start receiving (or Ctrl+R) to let your iPhone find this PC.

data.name: Pin_Title
data.value: Enter this code on your iPhone

data.name: Ask_Body
data.value: {0} wants to mirror to this PC. Replace {1}, or keep {1} and refuse?

data.name: R_Rotate
data.value: Turn the window when the phone rotates

data.name: R_Info
data.value: Show picture info over the picture

data.name: Monitor_Same
data.value: The one the window is on

data.name: R_Reset
data.value: Back to the picture as the phone sends it

data.name: R_Audio
data.value: Play the sound on this PC

data.name: R_Startup
data.value: Run when I sign in to Windows

data.name: H_Name
data.value: What your device lists under Screen Mirroring. Empty means this computer's name.

data.name: H_AutoStart
data.value: Otherwise press Start receiving (or Ctrl+R) when you want to be found.

data.name: H_Pin
data.value: Makes the phone ask for a code before it may connect. "New code" shows a fresh 4-digit code on this screen each time, like an Apple TV.

data.name: H_PinCode
data.value: The code the phone has to enter; 1 to 63 characters.

data.name: H_Second
data.value: What happens when a phone tries to connect while another one is already mirroring.

data.name: H_Address
data.value: Receive on one adapter only. Useful with a VPN, virtual adapters or a phone hotspot; "All adapters" is right for most people.

data.name: H_Ports
data.value: Fixed port numbers for firewalls. 0 lets Windows pick free ones each time.

data.name: H_Quality
data.value: The picture size the phone is asked to send. Lower means less Wi-Fi traffic and CPU.

data.name: H_Fps
data.value: The most frames per second the phone sends. 30 is easier on slow machines and networks.

data.name: H_Hw
data.value: Decode the video on the graphics card. Turn off only if the picture is broken or black.

data.name: H_Low
data.value: Show each frame as soon as it arrives. Off trades a frame or two of delay for a steadier picture.

data.name: H_Scaler
data.value: How the picture is enlarged when the window is bigger than it. Sharp costs a little GPU.

data.name: H_Rotate
data.value: The window turns round its centre when the phone rotates; off keeps the window as it is and adds bars.

data.name: H_Info
data.value: Picture size, frame rate, processing time and decoder, in the top-left corner of the picture (Ctrl+I).

data.name: H_Monitor
data.value: Where F11 full screen goes on a computer with several monitors.

data.name: H_Matrix
data.value: How the phone's video colours are converted. Auto picks BT.709 for HD and BT.601 below; change it only if colours look off.

data.name: H_Range
data.value: Whether black is at 16 or 0. Auto (limited) is right for AirPlay; full makes a washed-out picture punchier, or crushes it.

data.name: H_Brightness
data.value: Lifts or lowers the whole picture. 0 is as sent.

data.name: H_Contrast
data.value: Spread between dark and light. 0 is as sent.

data.name: H_Saturation
data.value: Colour strength; -100 is black and white. 0 is as sent.

data.name: H_Hue
data.value: Shifts all colours round the colour wheel. 0 is as sent.

data.name: H_Audio
data.value: Off keeps the sound on the phone.

data.name: H_AudioDevice
data.value: Speakers or headphones to play on. "Default device" follows Windows' sound settings.

data.name: H_Volume
data.value: The phone's volume buttons set this app's volume in the Windows mixer.

data.name: H_Theme
data.value: Light or dark look; "Same as Windows" follows the Windows setting.

data.name: H_Colour
data.value: Accent used for buttons and the chosen page.

data.name: H_Startup
data.value: Starts in the tray when you sign in; receiving still follows the setting above.

data.name: H_Close
data.value: Quit, or keep receiving in the background with an icon in the tray.

data.name: H_Log
data.value: What is written to the log files; "Everything" is for reporting a problem.

data.name: About_Desc
data.value: A small AirPlay receiver for Windows: mirror your iPhone or iPad screen, with sound, to this PC.

data.name: About_Licence
data.value: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3.

data.name: Msg_AppliesLater
data.value: This change applies after the current phone disconnects.

data.name: Msg_AddressFallback
data.value: The chosen network adapter is not available; receiving on all adapters.

data.name: ErrNoDecoder
data.value:
No H.264 video decoder was found.
On Windows N editions, install the Media Feature Pack (Settings > Apps > Optional features), then start LiteMirror again.

data.name: ErrMdnsUnavailable
data.value: LiteMirror needs Windows 10 version 1809 or later.

data.name: ErrMdnsRegister
data.value: Windows could not announce LiteMirror on the network. Check that the computer is on the same Wi-Fi as your phone and that the network is set to Private.

data.name: ErrPort
data.value: Another program is using a network port LiteMirror needs. Close it, or choose other ports in Settings.

data.name: ErrNoD3D
data.value: Direct3D 11 is not available on this computer, so the picture cannot be shown. Update the graphics driver and try again.

data.name: ErrAddress
data.value: The chosen network adapter has no address right now.
